## User task and change

Who benefits, where does this fit, and what changes for them?

## Claim and evidence

Exact property or measured result; baseline, assumptions, source/revision and evidence level.
If research: GO / HOLD / NO-GO for which route, and the next discriminating test.

## Verification

Commands actually run, tested SHA/target, outcomes and meaningful negative cases.
List failed, skipped or unavailable checks separately; do not mark them passed.

## Integration and remaining work

API/language compatibility, dependencies, deployment effort, unsupported cases and follow-up owner.

## Attribution

Original sources, data/code license, contributors and AI assistance. Explain any novelty claim.
